purpose: compare FNO against simple nominal secant at the same observable residual reduction; development only
accept: strict physical squared receiver residual decrease
stop: relative receiver residual <= initial relative residual * .001; threshold is prospective for this new development batch, not a final-test acceptance threshold
timing: synchronize CUDA at boundaries; include initial solve, all accepted/rejected proposals, input encoding and response generation; separately charge model load, observations and historical offline cost; distinguish per-case direction and shared direction reuse
report: final parameter error only after stopping
reached tolerance or censored at cap
actual online wall time and calls
no amortization count unless incremental offline cost and positive matched-quality savings both known
scope: known support and reused depths; not blind inversion, not full traditional adjoint FWI comparison
